neighbours.label: Authors introduce a reusable experimental protocol or measurement method in scientific prose.
fire: In this report, we describe a protocol for measuring membrane permeability in cultured epithelial cells.
Here we describe how to quantify the movement of individual bacteria using time-lapse microscopy.
We describe a reproducible method for measuring the stiffness of isolated plant tissues.
In the present article, we outline a protocol for detecting fluorescent markers in developing embryos.
Here we describe an experimental procedure to assess oxygen consumption in purified mitochondria.
This paper describes how to measure the rate of diffusion through a synthetic membrane.
We describe a detailed protocol for recording calcium signals from living muscle fibers.
In this study, we present a method to quantify the adhesion of cells to coated glass surfaces.
quiet: The researchers measured membrane permeability in epithelial cells after two days of culture.
During the experiment, individual bacteria moved across the slide while a camera recorded their positions.
The laboratory measured the stiffness of isolated plant tissues collected from six specimens.
Fluorescent markers were detected in the embryos at three stages of development.
The investigators assessed oxygen consumption after preparing purified mitochondria from each sample.
Diffusion through the synthetic membrane was measured at several temperatures during the trial.
The team recorded calcium signals from living muscle fibers and stored the resulting traces.
Cell adhesion to coated glass surfaces was measured after the samples had incubated overnight.

notes: The card emphasizes describe, protocol and method in research descriptions. Probes were stronger for introducing a measurement protocol than for reporting completed experiments; some paraphrases remained weak, so lexical framing may matter.
